rows.Kwic: 說似一物即不中祖云還假修證也無

Override.AttributionNote: Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters (古尊宿語錄), Nanyue Huairang's biography. After eight years attending Huineng, Nanyue Huairang reports his insight by saying that describing it as one thing would miss it; Huineng then asks whether cultivation and verification are still needed. Huineng is the respondent, not the speaker of the headword-bearing statement.

Override.AttributionNote: Old Recorded Sayings of Venerable Masters (古尊宿語錄), in Shoushan Xingnian's section. An unnamed monk is the exact speaker who asks whether there is an upward matter and then asks what the upward matter is; Shoushan answers first 'yes' and then 'a person from Silla does not wrap his head.' The line, expanded context, section header, book title, TEI header, exact full-case search, and parallel passages do not name this monk.
